title: Sticky Chicken with Colcannon
rawIngredients: ½ Savoy cabbage, cored and shredded
method: Preheat the grill to medium-high with an upper oven rack positioned near the element.
Place potatoes in salted cold water, bring to a boil, and simmer for 8 minutes. Add shredded cabbage and cook for 4 more minutes, then drain and steam dry.
Return the potato mixture to the pot and mash with spring onions, butter, milk, salt, and pepper.
Whisk Dijon mustard, wholegrain mustard, and honey in a shallow bowl. Season chicken breasts and coat thoroughly in the honey-mustard glaze.
Place glazed chicken on a lined baking tray and grill for 4–5 minutes per side until cooked through and caramelised.
Rest chicken briefly, slice into strips, and serve over warm colcannon.
